title: What a scale is
summary: A scale is a set of notes in order, from one note up to the same letter again.

steps.title: Scale
steps.body:
A **scale** is a set of notes played in order, going up or down, from one note to the same letter an octave away. You already played one in Unit 2: every key from C to C, a half step at a time.

**Why it matters:** Most tunes are built from the notes of one scale. When a band mate says "just stay in the scale", they mean these notes will all fit.

steps.title: A scale on the white keys
steps.body: The white keys from C up to the next C are a scale: eight notes, starting and ending on C.

items.prompt: Play C D E F G A B C going up.
Start on C and play every key going up, a half step at a time, until you reach the next C.

steps.title: Stay in the scale
steps.body: Play the white keys from C to C slowly, then make up a tune using only those notes. Everything you play will fit together.

items.prompt: Play C D E F G A B C going up, without looking.
Start on D and go up a whole step at a time until you reach the next D.
